title: Dimension reduction for density superlevel sets of minimizing currents (Appendix A.4 applied to density thresholds)
statement: Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n and ℓ ≤ k, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, let N be an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let c > 0, d₀ ∈ ℕ, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with closedBall z (2r) ⊆ U. Call S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) an admissible zero-scale limit if S is the weak limit in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly) of the blow-ups η_{x_i,λ_i#}T (blowUp T x_i λ_i) for some points x_i ∈ B_r(z) and scales λ_i > 0 with λ_i → 0, and S is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂S = 0. Assume (H1): no admissible zero-scale limit S has Θ^n(μ_S, y) = c'·1_Q(y) for all y (HasMassDensity S y (indicator of Q with value c')) for some n-dimensional linear subspace Q and some real c' ≥ c; and (H2): no admissible zero-scale limit S admits a linear subspace L with d₀ ≤ dim L < n such that HasMassDensity S w θ implies HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ for all y ∈ L, λ > 0, w, θ, and such that {y : ∃θ ≥ c, HasMassDensity S y θ} = L. Let Z(s) := {x ∈ B_s(z) : ∃θ ≥ c, HasMassDensity T x θ} (the points of B_s(z) with Θ^n(μ_T, x) ≥ c). Then μH[d₀ − 1 + α](Z(r)) = 0 for every real α > 0; Z(r) = ∅ if d₀ = 0; and Z(r/2) is finite if d₀ = 1.
